P.name: Double Strike
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Master Yi's''' {{tip|basic attack|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} generate a {{tip|stack}} of ''Double Strike'' for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, '''Master Yi's''' next basic attack {{tip|on-attack}} is empowered to consume the stacks {{tip|on-hit}} and strike twice, the second strike dealing {{as|50% AD}} {{as|physical damage}}.
P.description2: The second strike applies {{tip|on-hit}} effects, triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, and is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.
P.description3: If '''Master Yi's''' primary target is killed before the second strike, he will automatically target another nearby enemy.
P.description4: ''The second strike can {{tip|critical strike|critically strike}} against {{tip|turrets|structures}}.''

Q.name: Alpha Strike
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Master Yi''' {{tip|vanish|vanishes}} and becomes {{tip|lockout|unable to act}}. After {{rutngt|0.2}}, he marks the target enemy and then proceeds to mark the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} un-marked enemy within 600 units, recurring every {{rutngt|0.2}}{{ft|up to 3 times.|for a total of 4 marks.}}If there are no other un-marked targets before then, '''Master Yi''' can mark the same enemies again. During ''Alpha Strike'', '''Master Yi''' can select a direction from the primary target.
Q.description2: Upon finishing marking, '''Master Yi''' {{tip|blinks|reappears}} 75 units in the targeted direction, or in front of the target otherwise, and then becomes able to act again{{ft|after {{rutngt|0.15}}.|{{tt|{{fd|1.087}} seconds total|Effective time due to game ticks}} after the start of the cast with 4 bounces.}}If the primary target {{tip|death|dies}} or is too far away during the delay, '''Master Yi''' will reappear at the initial cast location instead.
Q.description3: '''Master Yi''' then detonates the marks to deal {{as|physical damage}} and apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects, with on-hit damage reduced to 75% effectiveness. Marks after the first on the same target instead detonate instantly upon application to deal {{fd|{{#expr:0.25*100}}}}% damage and apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects, with on-hit damage reduced to {{ap|75*0.25}}% effectiveness. ''Alpha Strike'' deals {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} to {{tip|monster|monsters}} per hit.
Q.leveling3:
{{st|Primary Physical Damage|{{ap|20 to 100}} {{as|(+ {{fd|70}}% AD)}}|Reduced Damage per hit|{{ap|20*0.25 to 100*0.25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*0.25}}% AD)}}|Maximum Single-Target Damage|{{ap|20*(1+0.25*3) to 100*(1+0.25*3)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*(1+0.25*3)}}% AD)}}}}
{{st|Primary Bonus Monster Damage|{{ap|60 to 160}}|Combined Primary Monster Damage|{{ap|20+60 to 100+160}} {{as|(+ {{fd|70}}% AD)}}|Reduced Monster Damage per hit|{{ap|(20+60)*0.25 to (100+160)*0.25}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*0.25}}% AD)}}|Max Single-Target Monster Damage|{{ap|(20+60)*(1+0.25*3) to (100+160)*(1+0.25*3)}} {{as|(+ {{ap|70*(1+0.25*3)}}% AD)}}}}
Q.description4: ''Alpha Strike's'' primary and lesser damage can {{tip|critically strike}} for{{ft|{{as|{{critical damage|({{ccd|Master Yi|crit_base}}-100)*1+100|1*100}}|critical damage}} damage.<!--and {{as|{{critical damage|(({{ccd|Master Yi|crit_base}}-100)*1+100)*0.25|1*100*0.25}}|critical damage}} damage respectively.-->|100% + {{sti|critical damage|{{as|{{ap|1*100}}% of {{as|'''bonus''' critical damage}}}}.}}<!--, reduced to {{ap|0.25*100}}% for the lesser damage.-->}}<!--V26.01 - Lesser damage is now bugged and can critically strike for full damage (x1.0, same crit damage value as primary damage), when the crit damage modifier should be getting modified to x0.25 like it's supposed to. Will probably be fixed in a patch or two.-->
Q.description5: {{tip|Basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} reduce ''Alpha Strike's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} by 1 second, {{tt|affected by {{as|{{sti|ability haste}}}}|Cooldown reduction on-hit is reduced with ability haste}}.
Q.description6: ''{{ai|Wuju Style|Master Yi}} and {{ai|Highlander|Master Yi}} can be cast during Alpha Strike. Each time Alpha Strike hits a target, the '''current''' durations of {{ai|Wuju Style|Master Yi}} and {{ai|Highlander|Master Yi}} are refreshed. Alpha Strike does not trigger its cooldown reduction nor grant a stack of {{ai|Double Strike|Master Yi}} when applying on-hit effects.''

W.name: Meditate
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Master Yi''' {{tip|channels}} for up to 4 seconds, {{tip|healing}} himself every {{fd|0.5}} seconds, increased by {{as|{{pp|type='''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% missing health}}|health}}.
W.leveling:
{{st|Minimum Heal Per Tick|{{ap|15 to 55}} {{as|(+ {{fd|12.5}}% AP)}}|Maximum Heal Per Tick|{{ap|15*2 to 55*2}} {{as|(+ 25% AP)}}}}
{{st|Minimum Total Heal|{{ap|15*8 to 55*8}} {{as|(+ 100% AP)}}|Maximum Total Heal|{{ap|15*8*2 to 55*8*2}} {{as|(+ 200% AP)}}}}
W.description2: While channeling, '''Master Yi''' gains 70% damage reduction for the first {{fd|0.5}} seconds, which is then modified to a reduced amount for the remaining duration of the channel. ''Meditate's'' damage reduction is halved against {{tip|turret|turrets}} and lingers for {{fd|0.5}} seconds after the channel ends.
W.leveling2: {{st|Modified Damage Reduction|{{ap|45 to 55}}%|Turret Modified Damage Reduction|{{ap|45/2 to 55/2}}%}}
W.description3: ''Meditate {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Master Yi's''' basic attack timer, pauses {{ais|Wuju Style|Master Yi}} and {{ais|Highlander|Master Yi}} duration, and grants one stack of {{ai|Double Strike|Master Yi}} per second during the channel.''

E.name: Wuju Style
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Master Yi''' empowers his basic attacks within the next 5 seconds to deal {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' true damage}}}} {{tip|on-hit}}.

R.name: Highlander
R.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}} reduces the {{sti|'''current''' cooldowns}} of '''Master Yi's''' basic [[Champion ability|abilities]] by 70%.
R.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Master Yi''' {{tip|cleanse|cleanses}} himself from all {{tip|slow|slows}} and {{tip|cripple|cripples}}. For the next 7 seconds, he gains {{tip|ghosting}}, {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}}, {{tip|slow-immune|slow immunity}}, and {{tip|cripple-immune|cripple immunity}}.
R.leveling2:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|25 to 65}}%}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|40 to 60}}%}}
R.description3: While active, scoring a champion {{tip|takedown}} extends ''Highlander's'' duration by 7 seconds.
